verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway supports declarative, DB-less deployment and Docker installation that can run entirely locally without Konnect (kong-gh-4, kong-gh-7, kong-gh-20), and decK/kongctl let you manage configuration as local files (kong-docs-67, kong-docs-68). However, the documented quickstart path explicitly creates a Konnect cloud control plane and ties licensing to it (kong-docs-45), and there's no dedicated 'local workspace' concept or explicit confirmation that all features work fully offline without any Konnect account. Missing for 10: a documented fully offline quickstart/workflow that never touches Konnect, and independent confirmation of offline usage without a cloud account.
